text:
The same quality as the sun of your country
emerging from the clouds:
a cheerful, delicate shade upon leaves,
a glint of glass, a modulation
of the rain's muted gleam.

The same quality as your city,
your city of countless panes of glass,
the same yet different, changed by time:
streets I do not know and the old square
filled with birds,
the square where we kissed one night.

The same quality as your expression
after all these years,
looking at me tonight:
the same quality as your expression
and the wounded expression of your lips.

Love with the quality of life,
love without demands on the future,
the present of the past,
love more powerful than life:
lost and found.
Found, lost...

translation.title: Love More Powerful Than Life
